test_GTestEnvVarTest_testEnvVarAffectsFl: test that environment variables like GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE affect the corresponding Google Test flags
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFile: test that the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable sets the Google Test output flag to xml format
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFileOv: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE for the Google Test output flag
run_SetEnvVar: set or unset an environment variable in the test environment dictionary by name and value
run_GetFlag: run the googletest-env-var-test executable with a flag and return its output
